record.question: A Superintendent of Police is invited to deliver a lecture at a private university on challenges in policing. During the lecture, he expresses his personal disagreement with a recently announced Government policy on criminal justice administration. He makes it clear that the views are his own and not those of the Government. Which of the following is the most appropriate legal conclusion?
options: No violation because he expressly stated that the views were personal
No violation because the lecture was delivered in an academic institution
The officer may violate Rule 9, as a Government servant is restricted from publicly criticizing Government policy irrespective of the forum
Violation occurs only if the lecture is published in the media
